mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, a further decline signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 98.0 in a 1-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth and monthly housing starts indicates a severe slowdown in the real economy, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high retail sales environment, a decline in retail sales signals a loss of consumer spending momentum, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines in a high retail sales environment, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
